Don-Jo KP-4.25 x 29.5-605, 4.25" x 29.5" Polished Brass Kick Plate

The 4.25 x 29.5 Inch Polished Brass Kick Plate is made out of solid brass. The beautiful reason adds a nice finishing touch. After all, it is the details that make the room!

Specifications of the Don-Jo KP-4.25 x 29.5 Inch Wide and 24 Inch Long Kick Plate:

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Plate Width: 29.5"
  • Plate Height: 4.25"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Sold Individually
